page_title: WER 1-3 HOF | Werder Bremen v Hoffenheim 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
90+2' Frank Willenborg shows the yellow card to Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90+1' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Werder Bremen get a corner.
88' Here's the change. Andrej Kramaric leaves the pitch and Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
87' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' The resulting corner, taken by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
85' The foul by Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Frank Willenborg.

85' A sweet pass finds Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Luca Philipp is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
84' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Anthony Jung will be replaced by Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen).
83' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stanley Nsoki.
82' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
79' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) is flagged for offside.

78' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Anton Stach cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Gift Orban is replaced by Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim).
75' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
72' Half-chance! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) plays a pass into the box, but Michael Zetterer reacts well to snuff out the attack.

71' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

70' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and signals a foul after Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

68' What a big chance! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
67' Today's match ends for Marco Grull who will be replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.

65' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

63' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Andrej Kramaric and scores magnificently from close range low into the middle of the goal. 1:3.
62' The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
60' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
57' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
56' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) is booked for saying more than Frank Willenborg was willing to tolerate.
55' 2:3 – the corner kicks stats.
53' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

53' Hoffenheim show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hoffenheim.
52' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

51' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Michael Zetterer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
50' A yellow card for a tackle by Gift Orban (Hoffenheim). Frank Willenborg doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
50' Luca Philipp leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen).
49' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

48' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Hoffenheim win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ole Werner probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen). He is replaced by Derrick Kohn.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is replaced by Andre Silva.
46' Ole Werner has made a change at the break. Amos Pieper has come on in place of Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
42' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

42' Werder Bremen show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) prepares to take a corner kick.

39' Hoffenheim are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
38' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) for a tough tackle.
34' The free kick into the penalty area from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared.
33' 14:16 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:7.
31' Werder Bremen couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Luca Philipp (Hoffenheim) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
31' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) trips an opposition player and Frank Willenborg signals a foul. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
30' Wonderful movement by Werder Bremen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
28' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Andrej Kramaric provided an assist for the goal.
26' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer reacts superbly to deny him.
25' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
23' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
22' Chance! Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
20' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
17' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.

16' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
13' Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luca Philipp, who smothers the ball.

13' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball has crossed the sideline. Hoffenheim are taking a throw-in.
9' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Frank Willenborg to decide. The relieved Werder Bremen players can finally celebrate.
9' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Werder Bremen can stand using VAR.

7' 1 - 0 Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the right post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
6' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
4' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Werder Bremen are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
